_about: Grid Paper Editorial variant: ref rank 35 (rabinn.fx): white canvas, red serif-italic + bold sans words, archival B&W cut-outs on red discs, mostly graphic pages (paper > speaker).

director.pages: Paper-heavy: the speaker stays CUT OUT on a white page (ground beat, paper white) for almost the whole reel; few picture changes (~9/min). Use one long ground beat and at most one collage page. Trained: this plan scored 54.3 vs 31.3 for the base page plan.
